environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL server running in a Docker container (node:18-slim base) with default filesystem permissions. Container runs as root. Volume mount maps /app to host directory. PgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode fronting PostgreSQL 15. No filesystem isolation beyond container boundary. multer configured with default temp directory.

config.filesystem: writable, no chroot, no read-only mounts
